intent: Implement Photo Library V1 across persistence, worker processing, API, Workspace UI, packaging, and documentation.

findings.title: Worker could scan the wrong mount
findings.why_it_matters: A missing, replaced, or nested foreign mount could publish metadata from outside the configured storage pool.
evidence: The worker previously resolved only the root-relative path and did not verify findmnt source/target or recursive device identity.

findings.title: Queued refresh blocked batch uploads
findings.why_it_matters: The first accepted upload queued a refresh, causing every subsequent file in the same user-selected batch to return 409.
evidence: Upload readiness now checks for any completed full scan for the active library revision instead of the latest job state.

findings.title: Upload publication allowed target races
findings.why_it_matters: A target created between the existence check and publication could be overwritten or produce inconsistent duplicate state.
evidence: Uploads now use a same-directory temporary file, transactional reservation, and hard-link publication that fails with EEXIST.

findings.title: Applied migration contract was edited
findings.why_it_matters: Databases that had already applied migration 017 would reject pending asset rows even though fresh databases accepted them.
evidence: Migration 017 again permits only ready/failed assets; migration 018 adds a dedicated reservation table without rewriting existing schema.

findings.title: Cached media required a live mount
findings.why_it_matters: The photo wall lost usable cached thumbnails whenever the original storage pool was temporarily offline.
evidence: Current-revision WebP derivatives are now validated inside the cache root and served independently; originals remain mount-validated.

findings.title: Photo mutations left stale timelines
findings.why_it_matters: Move or trash approvals could succeed while deleted or moved assets remained visible until a periodic scan.
evidence: Successful and partially applied approvals now enqueue a full scan only when a source or target touches the active photo library.

findings.title: Polling missed external scan completions
findings.why_it_matters: The timeline could remain stale when jobs were queued or completed by approvals or another client between overlapping polls.
evidence: Polling is serialized with setTimeout and refreshes the timeline whenever a completed status revision changes.

findings.title: Derivative cache grew without cleanup
findings.why_it_matters: Deleting photos or changing libraries left generated WebP files consuming storage indefinitely.
evidence: A complete full scan now removes only old generated hash files that no current ready asset references.

findings.title: Mobile icon controls lacked names
findings.why_it_matters: Responsive CSS hides button text, leaving assistive technology without stable action names.
evidence: Toolbar and selection actions now retain aria-label values when visible text is hidden.

advisory: Dedicated ZOS Agent photo-library tools are not included in UI/API V1.
Run target Debian amd64/arm64 validation for HEIC conversion, Sharp native loading, systemd, and real storage mounts before release.

verification.tests: passed: Rust 71, Vitest 641 with 4 skipped, docs 5
verification.browser: passed at 1440x900 and 320x800 with no overflow or browser errors
